title: DeliveryWindow LocalDate range changed to Instant timestamp
query: What breaks across repositories if the delivery window changes from LocalDate from/to dates to an Instant timestamp?

proposed_change.diff:
-public record DeliveryWindow(LocalDate from, LocalDate to) {}
+public record DeliveryWindow(Instant at) {}

affected_repositories.name: shipment-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: owns DeliveryWindow, DeliveryEstimate, DeliveryEstimator, Shipment, and MyBatisShipmentRepository mapping

affected_repositories.name: order-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: ShipmentClient consumes the estimate shape for checkout quotes

affected_repositories.name: commerce-web
affected_repositories.evidence_note: checkout preview renders the estimated delivery window

notes: Domain-semantic change inside a shaped object. Date-range to instant is not serially compatible: Jackson binds by shape, and every reader of from/to breaks while the endpoint path stays identical.
